True when the status of the specified order_id has been checked before attempting the current action (any prior lookup confirms status such as pending, processed, or delivered).
True if the user has responded with 'yes' to proceed with the exchange/return.
The order status for the relevant order is now 'exchange requested' as a result of performing the exchange_delivered_order_items action (with confirmation).
rule_list.logic: (exchange_delivered_order_items AND order_delivered AND order_status_checked_before_action AND user_confirmed_yes) IMPLIES order_status_exchange_requested

rule_list.description: The agent must not change the order status to 'exchange requested' before user confirmation.
predicates: True if the user has responded with 'yes' to proceed with the exchange/return.

rule_list.description: The agent must send an email to the user regarding how to return items after user confirmation.
predicates: True when the user has explicitly confirmed to proceed with returning the items for the order referenced by this action (i.e., confirmed the return for the current order_id). This confirmation is the trigger to proceed with the return workflow.
True when an email has been sent to the user containing instructions on how and where to return the items for the order referenced by this action.

rule_list.description: The agent must not require the user to place a new order to exchange items from a delivered order.
predicates: True when performing exchange_delivered_order_items would require the user to place a separate new order to obtain the replacement items, rather than fulfilling the exchange within the existing delivered order. This occurs if: (a) for any product being exchanged, the total requested exchange quantity exceeds the quantity of that product delivered in order_id, e.g. delivered 1 unit but exchange requests 2 units; or (b) the requested replacements cannot be fulfilled in the same transaction due to stock constraints (no available stock to ship the replacements in this transaction).
